problemStatement.formal: \exists H, \forall N, \exists p > N, p \text{ prime} \wedge (p' - p \leq H)
problemStatement.plain: There exist infinitely many pairs of consecutive primes differing by at most H, for some finite H. Best known: H ≤ 246 (Polymath), H ≤ 12 assuming Elliott-Halberstam.
